## 📄 Revised specification — Bookmark Manager (round 2)

`specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md` · **single-user, no login** confirmed

### Every one of your expectations is now in the spec

| Your request | Where it landed |
|---|---|
| Auto-collect title, description, favicon, preview; edit title/description before or after | **US1**, FR-002, FR-003, FR-005 |
| Duplicate address → open existing bookmark for editing | **US1** scenario 5, FR-006 |
| List rows show title, description, tags, favicon | **US2**, FR-008 |
| Search over title/description/notes/address, case-insensitive; phrases; `#tag`; AND/OR/NOT/brackets | **US2**, FR-012–FR-016 |
| Suggest existing tags while typing | **US5**, FR-018 |
| Read-later state + separate unread view + mark read | **US3**, FR-021, FR-022 |
| Sorting incl. date added and title | **US2**, FR-010 |
| Bulk actions on a selection *or* all matching — tag/untag, read/unread, archive, delete | **US6**, FR-023, FR-024 |
| Archive: reversible, distinct from delete, hidden from list/search, own view | **US7**, FR-025, FR-026 |
| Notes with simple formatting, rendered properly | **US8**, FR-027 |
| Saved filters combining search + included/excluded tags | **US9**, FR-028 |
| Offline copy where possible; PDFs as PDFs; optional Internet Archive | **US10**, FR-029, FR-030 |
| Import/export browser HTML retaining titles, tags, saved dates | **US11**, FR-031, FR-032 |
| Display preferences: default sort, density, text size | **US12**, FR-033 |
| Web app; no browser extension this version | Assumptions |

### A few reasonable defaults I baked in — flag any you'd change
- **New bookmarks start unread** by default (read-later is the primary flow).
- **Duplicate matching is by normalized address** (scheme, host case, trailing slash) — not by page content.
- **Preservation & metadata capture are best-effort** and never block saving; a page that can't be captured still saves with an "offline copy unavailable" indicator.
- **Bulk delete** keeps the same confirm/undo safeguard as single delete.

### Priorities
P1 = Save (US1), Browse/sort/find (US2). P2 = Read-later, Edit/delete, Tags, Bulk, Archive. P3 = Formatted notes, Saved filters, Preservation, Import/export, Preferences. Each story is independently testable.

---
